tools.name: scan_wallet_risks
tools.description: Read-only audit of a Polymarket @username, profile URL, or 0x proxy wallet address for subjective rule traps, 95c tail-yield wipeout risk, and active UMA disputes.

tools.name: get_live_uma_disputes
tools.description: Fetch Polymarket UMA Optimistic Oracle V2 requests filtered by state (Disputed, Proposed active 2h liveness, Settled, or Slashed) with decoded titles, bond sizes, and resolution risk scores.

tools.name: check_proposer_reputation
tools.description: Inspect a Polygon UMA proposer 0x EVM address for total proposals, dispute rate, and slash (overturned proposal) rate.

tools.name: analyze_resolution_risk
tools.description: Score a Polymarket market title and resolution criteria text for too-early proposal risk, subjective consensus wording, 50-50 void traps, and bulletin-board amendability.

tools.name: check_kalshi_divergence
tools.description: Compare Polymarket resolution criteria against a cached Kalshi CFTC contract ticker to detect cross-venue double-loss divergence (early-close, cutoff gap, settlement source mismatch).

tools.name: get_curated_divergence_pairs
tools.description: List curated high-volume Polymarket vs Kalshi cross-venue rule divergence audits with pre-computed verdict (SAFE, CAUTION, BLOCK_ARB) and scenario risk breakdown.
